status: proposed construction - calculated, not built or measured
construction: 3 x Yunlu N-R-564440 rectangular nanocrystalline cores (56 x 44.6 x 40 mm, window 33 x 21.6 mm) in a flat-mu grade (mu 30000 +/-25 %, RFQ), stacked over the phase bars (N = 1): three-wire 3 bars 25 x 3 mm flat-stacked; four-wire 4 bars 16 x 4.5 mm on edge; bars sleeved 1 mm

electrical.note: B_LF independent of the number of cores at N = 1 (mu I / le); DM leakage taken as 0.3 % of L_cm (ASSUMED)

core.datasheet: docs/datasheets/magnetics/Yunlu-Nanocrystalline-Cores.pdf p.13 (rectangular CM cores, table 2: N-R-564440 56 x 44.6 x 40 mm, window 33 x 21.6 mm, Ae 345 mm2, le 134.4 mm) and p.6 (adjustable mu); flat grade mu 30 000 +/-25 % = RFQ (MAS reference material SC-1K107-LP)
core.asian_alternative: this is the Asian part; Shincore SC-1K107-LP is the MAS reference material

windings.name: phase bars
windings.conductor: three-wire 25 x 3 mm Cu; four-wire 16 x 4.5 mm
windings.arrangement: bars centred in the window (DM leakage)

insulation.system: sleeved bars (>= 1 mm, rated 1.5 kV rms) inside cased cores; mains side basic (OVC III) as L2
insulation.routine_tests: L_cm at 32 kHz, 1 V; bar-core 1.5 kV rms 1 s
insulation.type_tests: impulse 6 kV; L_cm with 1.25 A rms 150 Hz CM bias

core.formula: negligible (B_HF ~ 0.04 T at 32 kHz on a flat nanocrystalline grade)

winding.referred_to: the bars (busbar loss counted with the AC port)

thermal.airflow: 3 x AFB1224SHE-F00: 149 m3/h per heatsink section; the inductors sit downstream of the heatsink in the same duct (pcs_spec), so the air reaching them is pre-heated by the section's semiconductor loss (426 W -> +9.2 K); h = 25 W/m2K on the exposed coil and core surfaces (about 4 m/s past a 0.1 m body, ASSUMED - the duct section around the inductors is not drawn)

cost.basis: ESTIMATES: flat nanocrystalline 20 USD/kg + 1.5 USD case per core; insulation 3; labour 2 + 0.5/core; +10 %; Y1 capacitors not included (the study's row includes 3 x Y1)

previous_designer.study: AC common-mode choke >= 150 uH at 32 kHz: 3 nanocrystalline cores over the phase busbars + 3 x Y1
